output.question: What are C&S Wholesale Grocers' subsidiaries?

passages.quote: Today, the C&S family of companies — including Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group™, Davidson Specialty Foods and SpartanNash
today announced the completion of its acquisition of SpartanNash Company
In 2016, Davidson Specialty Foods became a wholly owned subsidiary of C&S Wholesale Grocers
The business will continue to operate under the respected FreshKO brand as a wholly-owned subsidiary of C&S Wholesale Grocers, Inc.
Today, Piggly Wiggly Midwest operates as part of C&S Wholesale Grocers, one of the largest grocery wholesalers in the United States.
Piggly Wiggly®, LLC is an affiliate of C&S Wholesale Grocers
C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC (C&S) has announced a proposed transaction to be the majority owner of The Winn-Dixie Company (Winn-Dixie).
The transaction is expected to close in early 2027.

output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, C&S Wholesale Grocers’ publicly documented subsidiaries and operating businesses include SpartanNash, Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, Davidson Specialty Foods, FreshKO Produce Services and Piggly Wiggly Midwest. SpartanNash’s acquisition was completed on September 22, 2025; Davidson Specialty Foods and FreshKO are explicitly described as wholly owned subsidiaries. This is a documented shortlist, not a verified complete legal-subsidiary roster, and Piggly Wiggly, LLC is described as an affiliate rather than explicitly as a subsidiary. The latest announcement reviewed describes majority ownership of Winn-Dixie as a proposed transaction, announced August 13, 2026 and expected to close in early 2027—not a completed majority-ownership acquisition.
caveats: The sources do not provide a complete current legal-entity ownership schedule. Membership in the C&S 'family of companies' does not establish whether a business is a direct or indirect subsidiary.
Several supporting pages are undated. The Winn-Dixie closing timetable is forward-looking, so it should not be treated as confirmation of completed majority ownership.

Piggly Wiggly, LLC describes itself as an affiliate of C&S Wholesale Grocers, not explicitly as a subsidiary.
